versions.subject: feat: update curl & wget rules
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    - Image|endswith: '\curl.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: 'curl.exe'
selection_ip:
    CommandLine|re: '://[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}'
selection_http:
    CommandLine|contains: 'http'
selection_flag:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - ' -O'  # covers the alias for --remote-name and --output
        - '--remote-name'
        - '--output'
selection_ext:
    CommandLine|endswith:
        - ".ps1"
        - ".ps1'"
        - '.ps1"'
        - ".dat"
        - ".dat'"
        - '.dat"'
        - ".msi"
        - ".msi'"
        - '.msi"'
        - ".bat"
        - ".bat'"
        - '.bat"'
        - ".exe"
        - ".exe'"
        - '.exe"'
        - ".vbs"
        - ".vbs'"
        - '.vbs"'
        - ".vbe"
        - ".vbe'"
        - '.vbe"'
        - ".hta"
        - ".hta'"
        - '.hta"'
        - ".dll"
        - ".dll'"
        - '.dll"'
        - ".psm1"
        - ".psm1'"
        - '.psm1"'
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: Image="*\\curl.exe" OR OriginalFileName="curl.exe" CommandLine="*http*" CommandLine IN ("* -O*", "*--remote-name*", "*--output*") CommandLine IN ("*.ps1", "*.ps1'", "*.ps1\"", "*.dat", "*.dat'", "*.dat\"", "*.msi", "*.msi'", "*.msi\"", "*.bat", "*.bat'", "*.bat\"", "*.exe", "*.exe'", "*.exe\"", "*.vbs", "*.vbs'", "*.vbs\"", "*.vbe", "*.vbe'", "*.vbe\"", "*.hta", "*.hta'", "*.hta\"", "*.dll", "*.dll'", "*.dll\"", "*.psm1", "*.psm1'", "*.psm1\"") | regex CommandLine="://[0-9]{1,3}\\.[0-9]{1,3}\\.[0-9]{1,3}\\.[0-9]{1,3}"
